title: LTX is DEAD on the current engine - KJNodes calls .to() on a ModelPatcher
description: All 12 shipped LTX graphs crash at the stage-1 sampler on ComfyUI 0.30.x. ComfyUI f8a3fd9d (2026-07-25) made LatentUpscaleModelLoader return a ModelPatcher; KJNodes' LTX2SamplingPreviewOverride wrapper still did latent_upscale_model.to(device), and no patcher class has .to. Fixed by bumping the KJNodes pin to 35e5956, which carries kijai's _unwrap_upscale_model helper. Proven live on the bench.
acceptance: node_lock pins a KJNodes commit that carries _unwrap_upscale_model
An existing engine self-heals: the .mpi_node_commit drift check re-installs KJNodes at the new pin on boot
An LTX generation completes THROUGH THE APP on the app engine, not only on the bench
The Pod image is rebuilt or confirmed unaffected - it bakes nodes from this same lock
